$comment: Limits of text slots that no visible box measures (read by packages/cms/tracy-quickstart-tools/content-coverage/emdash-content-map.mjs into the content map). A number needs a real source: a box that was measured (how is said in `from`; Playwright, Chromium, 1440 / 768 / 390 px, on the running site of this theme) or a field's schema maxLength (none of these fields declares one). A text no page draws in a box has no number: it is declared `nonVisual` with where it is used, and the kit asks no limit of it.

limits.from: the site title is used only in the document `<title>` and `og:site_name` (Base.astro) and as the logo's alt text when neither the logo nor the business name has one: no page draws it in a box and the setting declares no maxLength, so it has no limit (the business name the footer prints is its own slot, chrome.brand_name, which is measured)

the business name is printed as words only in the footer copyright line (Footer.astro, `{name}` of `copyright`, 39 fixed characters around it); the line is one row at 1440 and 768 px and may take two rows at 390 px; filled with Latin running text until the line gains a row beyond that (Playwright, Chromium, the running site, 1440 / 768 / 390 px): the whole line takes 194 characters at 1440 px, 101 at 768 px (one row), 102 at 390 px (two rows), so 101 minus the fixed 39 = 62

the whole copyright line is one paragraph in the footer's bottom band; filled with Latin running text until it gains a row beyond today's (one row at 1440 and 768 px, two rows allowed at 390 px; Playwright, Chromium, the running site): 194 characters at 1440 px, 101 at 768 px, 102 at 390 px, counted as printed (`{year}` and `{name}` filled)
